checks.title: Source-specific reachability: sent/received, timeout count, RTT min/median/max
details: Device native probe or dedicated probe; critical paths 1m, other paths rotation
ICMP filtering/deprioritization differs from data-plane outage; compare H04/H13

checks.title: Delay distribution and variation: median, p95 after ≥100 samples, consecutive successful RTT differences
details: Rolling valid H01 samples; 5m evaluation
Call this RTT variation, not one-way jitter; preserve gaps and sample count

checks.title: Sustained loss and burst length
details: H01 or approved UDP receiver samples; 3-window decision
Retain denominator; one missed echo is not a confirmed outage

checks.title: TCP connect and service response from selected sources
details: Probe to allowed service/port; 5m
Distinguish reachability, connection refusal, timeout and service error; no broad port probing

checks.title: Physical-link error growth: CRC/FCS, alignment/input errors, packets and reset markers
details: Both adjacent supported interfaces; NMS cadence or 5m direct read
Measure rate and errors per million received frames where counters align; reset/wrap/discontinuity invalidates interval

checks.title: Optical diagnostics: receive/transmit levels, temperature and vendor alarm thresholds
details: Supported transceiver diagnostics; 15m or fault event
No universal optical dBm threshold; absent DOM is unsupported, not healthy

checks.title: Link flaps and negotiation: operational changes, speed/duplex, resets
details: Events + 5m reconciliation
Check both ends and expected media; do not force duplex or speed automatically

checks.title: Congestion: utilization, discards, queue drops, output errors, pause frames when available
details: Supported interface/queue counters; 5m
Average utilization can miss microbursts; do not claim line-rate capacity or specific cause from averages alone

checks.title: MTU/path packet-size failure
details: Small bounded DF/packet-size sequence from capable probes; daily and relevant incident
Filtered ICMP and tunnelling can make results inconclusive; no live MTU edit during test

checks.title: LAG health and member imbalance
details: Both ends' member state/counters; 5m
Distinguish a missing member from hash-dependent unequal traffic; verify intended minimum members

checks.title: Routing loop evidence
details: Bounded repeated traceroutes, route tables, TTL behavior; event/daily critical destinations
Repeated hops are a candidate; nonresponses/ECMP need corroboration. No high-rate traceroute storm

checks.title: Layer-2 loop indicators
details: STP changes, MAC moves, broadcast/multicast rates and interface evidence; event/5m
Correlated indicators, not proof from high broadcast alone; never inject a loop in production

checks.title: DNS availability, answer correctness and UDP/TCP consistency
details: Probe→authorized resolver with approved test name; 5m
Include recursion/authoritative expectation, response code and latency; use no client browsing records

checks.title: DHCP service/process and pool pressure
details: Server status/log aggregates/lease totals; 5–15m
Pools/lease counts are not active-client counts; warn on trend and accepted capacity policy

checks.title: DHCP relay and VLAN coverage
details: Relay configuration plus approved segment probe; after relevant change/daily
Ordinary renewals may not exercise discovery. A controlled lease test requires agreed test client/segment

checks.title: Unauthorized DHCP server evidence
details: Snooping/logs or approved passive observation point; event-driven
Capture only necessary headers/identities; server-ID alone can be spoofed; unmanaged local broadcasts may be invisible

checks.title: Default gateway/ARP-neighbour consistency
details: Probe and infrastructure ARP/ND/routing views; 15m/event
Virtual MAC/HA changes may be legitimate; compare accepted policy, no ARP poisoning

checks.title: Duplicate infrastructure address indicators
details: Conflicting identity/ARP events and verified interface addresses; event
Avoid endpoint sweep; qualify HA and aliases before declaring a duplicate

checks.title: Firewall/gateway path health
details: pfSense interface/gateway status plus explicit permitted source probes; 5m
Keep controller and forwarded-path results separate; inspect policy routing rather than declaring ISP down

checks.title: Resource pressure vs forwarding
details: CPU, memory, process/event history and independent service probes; 5m
A stable high-memory baseline is low headroom, not proof of a leak; Cisco/D-Link semantics differ

checks.title: Clock quality
details: Device/system time versus known reference; hourly
Record offset/uncertainty; cross-device causal ordering is inconclusive with unsynchronized clocks

checks.title: Configuration drift and unsaved changes
details: Snapshot diff, running/startup where supported; daily/change event
Exclude volatile fields carefully; a drift is not automatically wrong

checks.title: Approved path asymmetry or unexpected route change
details: Paired source-specific traces/routes; event/daily
ICMP paths/ECMP and asymmetry may be legitimate; compare explicit intent

checks.title: TCP throughput for selected path
details: iperf3 between approved infrastructure probes; explicit scheduled window
Default 10s, one stream, explicitly capped offered rate; not a capacity claim. Never target switch management CPU

checks.title: UDP loss/receiver jitter under known offered load
details: iperf3 between approved probes; same controlled window
Record datagram size/rate/duration and receiver jitter definition; not comparable with H02 RTT variation

checks.title: Latency under controlled load
details: Concurrent critical-path samples during H24/H25
Stop on agreed loss/latency impact; shows behavior at that load, not all campus workloads

checks.title: Error-rate change with traffic
details: H05 paired with traffic rates and pre/post intervention
Quiet links cannot establish repair; compare equivalent windows and retain uncertainty

checks.title: Monitoring/discovery coverage
details: Last poll, collector heartbeat, missing endpoints, parser completeness; each cycle
Separate a failed monitor from an observed network failure; no freshness from API retrieval alone

checks.title: Backup/access readiness
details: Snapshot age/hash/restore availability and key capability; daily/read activity
A key being loaded is not successful device login; avoid extra login attempts to held targets

checks.title: Post-action verification bundle
details: Appropriate subset of H01–H29 plus action-specific assertions; each repair
Success requires affected service outcomes as well as intended config; timeout cannot be success

rules.title: Authorized DHCP paths
details: Approved server/relay addresses, VLANs, actual paths, port roles, platform capabilities
Propose DHCP snooping or equivalent enforcement only on supported segments; show unmanaged segments still exposed

rules.title: DHCP snooping side effects
details: Relay behavior, Option 82 policy, trust direction, rate limits, binding persistence and legitimate server exceptions
Identify settings that would drop legitimate offers or break other protections; pilot and test before expanding

rules.title: Loop-prevention coverage
details: STP mode/root intent, port roles, BPDU observations, link aggregation
Propose root/edge/guard corrections; never classify a port as an edge solely because LLDP is absent

rules.title: VLAN/trunk consistency
details: Accepted VLAN use, both ends of a link, native/tagging configuration
Identify mismatched or unnecessarily exposed VLANs; check management and dependent services before pruning

rules.title: Link and LAG configuration
details: Speed/duplex, optics limits, member state, peer configuration and error/demand history
Distinguish configuration correction from an optic/cable replacement; never force speed on an unknown peer

rules.title: Single points of failure
details: Accepted physical links, routing/HA intent and measured demand
Name unprotected paths and likely affected services; a spare device or drawn second link is not proven failover

rules.title: Route and gateway behavior
details: Current routes, next-hop reachability, tracking/HA rules, return paths and policy routing
Identify loops, missing withdrawal or unintended paths; supported changes need a tested recovery route

rules.title: Address and subnet consistency
details: Infrastructure assignments, masks, DHCP scopes, reservations and gateway roles
Find overlaps, stale infrastructure records and conflicting assignments without inventorying clients

rules.title: Time and event reporting
details: Clock offsets, NTP configuration/reachability, syslog destination and actual receipt
Suggest reachable approved servers and event destinations; verify delivery, not just configuration text

rules.title: Management access boundaries
details: Required management methods, approved source networks, actual account privileges and host identity
Recommend scoped access and dedicated accounts while preserving required password/HTTP/Telnet access

rules.title: Key/account maintenance
details: Enrollment records, fresh key-auth test, account scope, key age/revocation policy
Suggest rotation or privilege correction; never remove the only verified recovery access

rules.title: Saved configuration and backups
details: Running/startup comparison where supported, successful backup/readback, restore qualification
Highlight unsaved changes and unqualified recovery; hash equality does not imply service health

rules.title: Resource and capacity margin
details: Demand percentiles, discard/error rates, CPU/DRAM trends, hardware limits
Explain sustained low headroom and likely bottlenecks; do not infer a memory leak from a flat high value

rules.title: Monitoring and test coverage
details: Expected check/source coverage, NMS poll age, credentials, probe placement
Name blind segments, stale polls and unavailable path tests; propose access/probe work rather than “all healthy”

rules.title: Configuration drift
details: Versioned accepted intent, approved change history and normalized observed configuration
Separate intentional changes awaiting review from unexplained drift; never silently restore the baseline

rules.title: Firewall/service dependencies
details: Approved service intents, firewall rules/order, gateways, NAT and observed path tests
Flag rule/intent conflicts for review; no automatic removal based only on a low hit count

rules.title: IPv6 control policy
details: Explicit IPv6 deployment decision, router/DHCPv6 roles, multicast requirements, platform support
Propose RA/DHCPv6 protections only when IPv6 policy is known; IPv4 DHCP rules do not cover IPv6

runbooks.title: Enroll/rotate a dedicated automation account and key
details: Exact account privilege/key support; fresh-session authentication; preserve existing administrator access; rollback only newly created scope

runbooks.title: Correct approved NTP or syslog destinations
details: Vendor-qualified diff and reversal, clock/receipt verification, no deletion of unrelated destinations; initial configuration-changing recovery demonstration

runbooks.title: Save an approved, verified running configuration
details: Explicit running/startup diff, no unnoticed unrelated changes; does not claim a save itself is a repair

runbooks.title: Apply authorized DHCP enforcement to a pilot segment
details: C01/C02 prerequisites, exact firmware lab test, legitimate DHCP verification and controlled unauthorized-offer test; staged expansion needs a new plan

runbooks.title: Correct a validated VLAN/trunk mismatch
details: Both link ends, management dependency, service tests and recovery access known; no blind trunk pruning

runbooks.title: Correct a validated route/tracking configuration
details: Lab-qualified platform, bounded prefix/next hop, return-path tests, recovery access; unsupported platforms remain preparation-only

runbooks.title: Restore the exact managed fields from a failed supported change
details: Read current state, detect intervening changes and preserve unrelated fields; no unconditional whole-device overwrite
